ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters representing approximately 15% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white clusters are concentrated on the lateral extremities; a significant contiguous irregular white patch is located on the far left lobe tip, while the central regions remain low-intensity.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge with irregular pixel-amplitude variations creating a jagged profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning to convex leading edge curves tapering to acute lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of small, circular high-contrast pixel rings and solid light-colored dots distributed across the majority of the visible dark ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular scarring and tissue loss on the distal tip of the left lobe, resulting in a shredded pixel boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast 'pock-marked' surface texture across both lobes caused by the dense spatial distribution of circular light-intensity anomalies.
